The gate still contains `!embedded && !inSharedMode && !isInDashboardContext && canEditInsight && !editingDisabledReason`. Embedded, shared and dashboard surfaces and users without edit permission remain excluded.

`canShowAlternatives` is unchanged: `!!featureFlags[FEATURE_FLAGS.PRODUCT_ANALYTICS_CHART_ALTERNATIVES] && isEditableSurface && isTrends && !!query && !!trendsSource`. The feature flag, trends-only and query-shape checks all still apply.

result:
The chart type gallery now shows in view mode on the insight page, in place of the plain dropdown. I haven't run any tests or the type check.

The gallery is gated by `isEditableSurface` in `products/product_analytics/frontend/insights/chartAlternatives/chartAlternativesLogic.ts`. That gate required `editMode`, so in view mode `canShowAlternatives` was false and `ChartAlternatives` fell back to the `ChartFilter` dropdown. I removed the `editMode` requirement (the selector input, the parameter and its type).

All the other conditions still apply. The gallery still needs the `PRODUCT_ANALYTICS_CHART_ALTERNATIVES` feature flag and a trends insight. It stays out of embedded, shared and dashboard contexts, and is disabled for users who can't edit the insight. In edit mode nothing changes.

I added a test in `ChartAlternatives.test.tsx` that renders with `editMode={false}` and checks the gallery trigger (`chart-alternatives-all`) is present.

Choosing a chart type in view mode changes the query in the same way the old dropdown did.
